<!--
  The simple purchase (model purchase@1): on a card surface, the heading and a description beside the price, one
  action and a note. Axes: layout (panel: the copy at the start, the price and the action at the end from md up,
  centered: one centred column).
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";

  export type PurchaseSimpleProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    description?: string;
    price: string;
    note?: string;
    actionLabel?: string;
    actionHref?: string;
    level?: 1 | 2 | 3;
    padding?: "compact" | "standard" | "spacious";
    layout?: "panel" | "centered";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Block from "../compose/Block.svelte";
  import Box from "../compose/Box.svelte";
  import Container from "../compose/Container.svelte";
  import LinkButton from "../compose/LinkButton.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import Title from "../compose/Title.svelte";
  import { cn, urlOf } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    description = "",
    price,
    note = "",
    actionLabel = "",
    actionHref = "",
    level = 2,
    padding = "standard",
    layout = "panel",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: PurchaseSimpleProps = $props();
  const titleId = $derived(id + "-title");
  const box = $derived(
    (layout as string) === "panel" ? "md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between md:gap-12"
    : "items-center"
  );
  const copyAlign = $derived(((layout as string) === "panel") ? "start" : "center");
  const copyText = $derived(((layout as string) === "panel") ? "text-start" : "text-center");
  const buy = $derived(((layout as string) === "panel") ? "md:items-end" : "");
</script>

<Block
  tag="section"
  class={
    (padding as string) === "compact" ? "py-8 lg:py-16"
    : (padding as string) === "spacious" ? "py-24 lg:py-40"
    : "py-16 lg:py-32"
  }
  aria-labelledby={(landmarkLabel ? undefined : titleId)}
  aria-label={landmarkLabel}
  data-slot="purchase-simple"
>
  <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4">
    <Box
      class={cn(
        "rounded bg-card p-6 text-card-foreground border border-border",
        "flex flex-col gap-8",
        box
      )}
    >
      <Stack gap="4" align={copyAlign} class="max-w-2xl">
        <Title as={level} size="2xl" weight="bold" class={cn("tracking-tight", copyText)} id={titleId}>
          {title}
        </Title>
        {#if description}
          <Text size="base" class={cn("text-muted-foreground", copyText)}>
            {description}
          </Text>
        {/if}
      </Stack>
      <Stack gap="4" align={copyAlign} class={cn("shrink-0", buy)}>
        <Text size="3xl" weight="bold" class={cn("tracking-tight", copyText)}>
          {price}
        </Text>
        {#if (actionLabel && actionHref)}
          <LinkButton variant="default" size="lg" href={urlOf(actionHref)}>
            {actionLabel}
          </LinkButton>
        {/if}
        {#if note}
          <Text size="xs" class={cn("text-muted-foreground", copyText)}>
            {note}
          </Text>
        {/if}
      </Stack>
    </Box>
  </Container>
</Block>
